Pale blue background, white screen and blue accents.

faults.what: The list text is garbled AI gibberish (e.g. 'Canery riotigs', 'Zragle riodd Ogte'), so the demo looks fake and broken.
The transformation is unclear. Overlapping blue blocks cover the messy text and no clean time-blocked plan appears.

summary: The calm blue-and-white palette works, but the demo shows gibberish text and overlapping blue blocks instead of a clear messy-to-organized plan, and the ClearDay end card can't be verified from the frames.
